description: Niños con interés en los planetas, marte y desafíos matemáticos
summary: We made an interactive web game that develops the difficulties to live and populate Mars, the game is funny to play, and can catch the attention of kids to play and learn at the same time, it is divided in two main modules, teaching the main difficulties to live in Mars, and the second module a live simulator that teaches kids how to manage important resources.
details:
This is a web based free video game that contains two modules.

The intended audience are kids from 7 to 12 years old to learn the difficulties to establish a Human colony in Mars.

The first module educates with mini games about the main difficulties and how to resolved them, it provides a quick explanation which is easy and funny to understand, and also contains direct links to main NASA website that explains the topic in deep, and since kids have the greatest imagination, we also ask them, how would they solve this difficulties, from where we can gather ideas and evaluate its viability in real life to analyze the best ideas for each issue, which is natural.
The second module teaches with a simulator once the colony is established on how to manage main resources such as oxygen, water, electricity and food, while improving the enviroments and caring about pets that gives us food like cows and chicken which our memeber suggested. (we can maybe change the name of the game to "how to bring a cow to Mars" later on :-) )

We used a brainstorming, and investigated the main issues to live in Mars and then with help of AIs coded the game as a web game as it was the easiest for us to end it during the event time window.
